sentences.en: Why would a benevolent god allow Hell to exist?
sentences.zh: 为什么仁慈的神会让地狱存在？

sentences.en: The treatment was made possible by a benevolent donor.
sentences.zh: 这种治疗是由于一位慷慨捐赠者资助才得以实现。

sentences.en: I think most of them are benevolent but misguided.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们大多数人是有善心但方向有误。

senses.zh: 仁慈的，乐善好施的；（用于慈善机构名称）慈善的，救济的
